## VAS installation notes

This is the UI-design Unslop by Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)),
from [heydamir/unslop](https://github.com/heydamir/unslop/tree/4652254daff586ff4739849395a127b56f7f8cc7),
upstream revision `4652254daff586ff4739849395a127b56f7f8cc7`.
Its original CC-BY-4.0 license, attribution, references and authored visual
examples are retained. Preserve this credit, the original repository link and
LICENSE in every copy/adaptation, and identify your changes. No endorsement by
the author is implied.

VAS canonical ID and installed folder: `heydamir-unslop`. The existing `unslop`
skill from MohamedAbdallah-14 processes prose through a CLI; it is a different
workflow and stays unchanged. Use this namespaced ID, not the prose CLI's name,
for installation, status and uninstall. Read SKILL.md through your agent's
existing skill discovery or request the UI workflow in natural language.

Copy Agent Prompt in the VAS catalog installs the complete verified snapshot
without cloning. CLI: `./vas install heydamir-unslop --target <agent> --mode copy`.
Link mode requires keeping the VAS checkout in place. Installation only
copies/links files and writes a CLI-compatible receipt: it never executes the
bundled helpers or examples, installs packages/browser binaries, connects an
MCP server or image service, generates paid images, captures a site or publishes
a story. References, examples/assets/blob.webp, LICENSE, CITATION.cff and all
scripts are included in this standalone folder.

Optional snapshot/story helpers need Node.js, separately approved
Playwright or playwright-core plus a compatible existing browser; story video
also needs ffmpeg. Use CHROME_PATH where applicable. Request permission before
dependency/browser installation or downloads and use the project's package
manager, never NPX. Missing prerequisites must be reported, not silently skipped.
For snapshotting, use only an authorized page: navigation executes site
JavaScript and may fetch remote styles/images/fonts; respect copyright, privacy,
authentication and service terms. Do not bypass site warnings or obtain access
without permission. Story playback executes the local HTML, serves its directory,
and video rendering writes output and removes its temporary frames; review
the helper and ask before overwriting files. Rendering, sensitive-data submission,
account/MCP connection, paid generation, uploads and publishing each require
separate authorization and an agreed budget where relevant.

VAS changes are documented in ADAPTATIONS.md and data/unslop-import.json:
namespace the YAML name, replace only the helpers' missing-Playwright NPX advice
with approval-first setup guidance, and append these packaging notes. The
original UI workflow, author credit, references, visual assets, examples and
helper logic remain intact. This import does not redesign the VAS website.
